description: Ontology of architectural component types with typed relations, material families, identification cues and sourced building examples. Types are not particular building instances.

components.name: Foundation
components.definition: Structural system conveying building loads into supporting ground
components.visualRecognition: Normally hidden, evidenced by footing plans and load-bearing substrate
components.exampleEvidence: The linked building source supplies contextual evidence; component-specific verification is a separate specimen gate.

components.name: Stereobate

components.name: Stylobate
